The CERN Doctoral Studentship programme page itself carries NO calendar deadline; it only says 'Apply with your CV (in English or French) and complete the online application before the deadline.' The explicit date quoted here is the deadline of the SINGLE currently published and only open round of the programme, TSC-2027-1/DOCT, which the official programme page lists under 'Open positions in the Doctoral Studentship' and links to this vacancy page. source.notes: TRUTHFUL UNKNOWN. I established from the live official AfDB pages that the JADS programme publishes NO central application opening or closing date at all, so there is no central JADS deadline to quote or date. The Application Procedures page states: 'Important:  All applications should go through the partner universities, no separate application to the African Development Bank is necessary.' Deadlines exist only as partner-university intake windows, which (a) differ per partner and per course, (b) are given as months or loose windows with no year, and (c) are all in the past or undated relative to 2026-10-05 because the pages were last updated 09-Nov-2022. Writing any single deadline_date here would require inventing a year. The shard's stored precision 'varies' is corroborated by live official evidence, and 'CONFLICTING / varies' would also be defensible, but I record UNKNOWN because no value could be established from the provider - the safer and contract-preferred result. Not a case of two sources contradicting each other; it is a structural absence of a programme-level deadline.

source.notes: NO DATE WRITTEN, BY RULE. The official Janelia application-details page gives the deadline as a bare day-and-month, 'December 3.', with NO year attached, and describes the annual cycle as 'Interested students should apply directly to the JHU Neuroscience program in the fall'. Supporting non-deadline wording on the same page: 'Students accepted into the Joint Graduate Program will be informed of their acceptance by JHU by the beginning of March' and 'All candidates will be notified of the Admission Committee's decision by April 15' (notification dates, not deadlines). The Janelia parent programme page states no deadline at all, so December 3 stands as the single official figure found.
